question: Should OpenClaw remove these root bundled skills now and ship Sherpa ONNX TTS as an official ClawHub-only plugin for this release?
rationale: The patch is coherent, but it intentionally changes bundled-skill availability, official install trust, dependency graph contents, and native artifact handling, which are product and security-boundary decisions rather than code-review-only questions.

options.title: Land after approval and upgrade proof
options.body: Resolve the current-head dependency graph guard and document the accepted upgrade path for removed bundled skill names plus Sherpa ClawHub availability before merge.

options.title: Split Sherpa from starter trimming
options.body: Land Sherpa ClawHub-only packaging separately if maintainers are ready for that trust path but not the broad bundled-skill removal.

options.title: Park the broad trim
options.body: Keep the current bundled set until a release-owned deprecation and migration plan is ready.

recommendation.title: Land after approval and upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Resolve the current-head dependency graph guard and document the accepted upgrade path for removed bundled skill names plus Sherpa ClawHub availability before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned and posted the maintainer updates that define this PR's remaining starter-skill/Sherpa decision surface.
